script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The text does not say anyone was in a room with Jeroboam or that nobody knew his concern.
The facts about David and Rehoboam come from outside the passage and need a reference.
Jeroboam speaks in his heart, not out loud.
The cherubim stood on their feet rather than sitting (2 Chronicles 3:13).
The passage does not identify where the people walked from, so it does not establish that the walk was long.
The statement about Shiloh in Israel's story needs a reference outside this passage.
The passage does not say Jeroboam invented a brand-new system, and people from every class does not mean people from all over geographically.
The statement about the Levites being set apart to serve needs a reference outside this passage.
Every class does not mean anybody. The passage specifies that the priests were not Levites.
The identification of Solomon as David's son and a former king needs a reference outside this passage.
The passage says the feast was like the one in Judah, but does not say Jeroboam was copying its look.
Saying Jeroboam made the feast to look like Judah's assigns him a purpose the text does not give.
The text does not place Jeroboam in front of both calves at Bethel; one was in Dan. It also does not say whether Levites were present at the feast.
The text does not mention elders at the altar, but it does not say they were absent.
